title: ZeST: A VLM-based Zero-Shot Traversability Navigation for Unknown Environments
abstract: arXiv:2508.19131v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Advances in robotics and autonomous navigation systems hinge on the ability to predict terrain traversability accurately. Traditional methods for generating datasets to train these prediction models often involve putting robots into potentially hazardous environments, posing risks to equipment and safety. To solve this problem, we present ZeST, a novel approach that treats repeated VLM outputs as stochastic measurements and fuses them into an uncertainty-aware posterior. Our approach not only performs zero-shot traversability and mitigates the risks associated with real-world data collection but also accelerates the development of advanced navigation systems, offering a cost-effective and scalable solution. To support our findings, we present navigation results, in both controlled indoor and unstructured outdoor environments. translated_title: ZeST：一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的未知环境零样本可通行性导航
translated_abstract: 机器人技术与自主导航系统的发展取决于精确预测地形可通行性的能力。传统方法在生成用于训练此类预测模型的数据集时，通常需要将机器人置于潜在危险的环境中，对设备和安全构成风险。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ZeST，一种新颖的方法，它将视觉语言模型（VLM）的重复输出视为随机测量，并将其融合为一种不确定性感知的后验估计。我们的方法不仅能实现零样本可通行性预测、规避与真实世界数据采集相关的风险，还能加速先进导航系统的开发，提供了一种低成本且可扩展的解决方案。为支持我们的研究结果，我们在受控室内环境和非结构化户外环境中展示了导航结果。如实验所示，ZeST提供了更安全的导航，成功率达到90-100%，而所有基线方法均未达到该水平。
tldr: 提出ZeST方法，将VLM的重复输出作为随机测量并融合为不确定性感知的后验估计，无需在危险环境中采集真实数据即可实现未知环境的零样本地形可通行性预测，在室内外环境中达到90-100%的导航成功率。
en_tdlr: ZeST treats repeated VLM outputs as stochastic measurements fused into an uncertainty-aware posterior, enabling zero-shot traversability navigation in unknown environments with a 90-100% success rate while eliminating the need for hazardous real-world data collection.
